import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int rounds = Integer.parseInt(scanner.nextLine());
        int[] first = Arrays.stream(scanner.nextLine().split(" "))
                            .mapToInt(Integer::parseInt)
                            .toArray();
        int[] second = Arrays.stream(scanner.nextLine().split(" "))
                             .mapToInt(Integer::parseInt)
                             .toArray();

        mainMethod(rounds, first, second);
        scanner.close();
    }

    public static void mainMethod(int r, int[] f, int[] s) {
        int total_wins = 0;
        int[] s_extended = new int[s.length + 1];
        System.arraycopy(s, 0, s_extended, 0, s.length);
        s_extended[s.length] = s[0];

        for (int idx = 0; idx < 3; idx++) {
            total_wins += Math.min(f[idx], s_extended[idx + 1]);
        }

        int[] s_copy = s.clone();
        s_copy = insertAtStart(s_copy, s[2]);

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (f[i] > 0) {
                int d = Math.min(f[i], s_copy[i]);
                f[i] -= d;
                s_copy[i] -= d;
                if (f[i] > 0) {
                    int d2 = Math.min(f[i], s_copy[i + 1]);
                    f[i] -= d2;
                    s_copy[i + 1] -= d2;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(Arrays.stream(f).sum() + " " + total_wins);
    }

    private static int[] insertAtStart(int[] array, int value) {
        int[] result = new int[array.length];
        result[0] = value;
        System.arraycopy(array, 0, result, 1, array.length - 1);
        return result;
    }
}
